questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select No improvement.**

The film by itself was good but __the bit long__ than I had expected.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is a bit longer​.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The three words—good, better, and best—are examples of the three forms of an adjective or adverb: positive, comparative, and superlative.
 
• The positive form of an adjective or adverb is the basic form listed in a dictionary.
 
• The comparative form (followed by 'than') is used when there is a comparison between two or more things.
 
• The superlative form is used for a thing which is better than any other of the same category.
 
• Example:
 
 
• *She is a good Cricketer.*
 
• *Rohit is a better human being than his brother.*
 
• *He is the best singer in our class.*
 
 
 
• Since there is a comparison (as suggested by the usage of the word 'than') being made in the given question, the comparative form of the given adjective i.e. longer must be used.
 
• As the required structure is followed in the given question, the 4th option will be the correct choice.

 

Correct Sentence__: The film by itself was good but **a bit longer than** I had expected.

questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

A. It is played by turning around while reciting a rhyme.

B. The circling motion is like that of a Sufi dervish.

C. Fahim Irshad has made a film called ‘Aani Maani’.

D. The movie title is based on a game popular among little children in Uttar Pradesh.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is CDAB.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• While arranging the parts of the passage, we should find some grammatical or contextual connections between them:
 
 
• Sentence C introduces us to the movie 'Aani Maani'. It is the introductory sentence and will be put in the first place.
 
• Sentence D tells us about the origin of the title of the above-mentioned movie. It will be put in second place.
 
• Sentence A tells us further about the game and how it is played. It will be put in third place.
 
• The last sentence is B as it mentions the comparison made with Sufi dervish.

 
 
 

Thus, the correct order is - *Fahim Irshad has made a film called ‘Aani Maani’. The movie title is based on a game popular among little children in Uttar Pradesh. It is played by turning around while reciting a rhyme. The circling motion is like that of a Sufi dervish.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct Indirect form of the given sentence.**

“It is a fact that kids model parental behaviour,” said the researcher.

options.text: The researcher said that it is a fact that kids model parental behaviour.
The researcher has said that it is a fact that kids have modeled parental behaviour.
The researcher has been saying that kids model parental behaviour.
The researcher says that it is a fact that kids model parental behaviour.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **The researcher said that it is a fact that kids model parental behaviour.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the steps to change the sentence from direct to indirect speech:
 
• When the direct speech is in an assertive form, we follow the steps given below:
 
 
• The reporting verb said will remain the same.
 
• Connector 'that' is used in place of comma and inverted commas.
 
• In the case of a general truth or universal fact (general truth in this case), there will be no change in the tense of reported speech.
 
• At last line up the remaining part.

 ​
 
 

**Following these steps, we finally get - ***The researcher said that it is a fact that kids model parental behaviour.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** *​​​​

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

Dr. Verma advised patients to try out a new medicine for migraine.

options.text: The patients were being advised to try out a new medicine for migraine by Dr. Verma.
The old patients had been advised to try out a new medicine for migraine by Dr. Verma.
Patients were advised to try out a new medicine for migraine by Dr. Verma.
Patients have been advised to try out a new medicine for migraine by Dr. Verma.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** Patients were advised to try out a new medicine for migraine by Dr. Verma.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in an active voice form, hence we need to convert it into a passive voice form.
 
• Find the subject (Dr. Verma) and object (Patients) of the sentence and exchange their places. 
 
• The given sentence is in the simple past tense. The passive verb form for simple past is: 
 
 
• was/were + past participle form of the verb.
 
• So, 'advised' changes to 'were advised'.
 
 
 
• At last line up the remaining part.

 ​

Following these steps, we get - *Patients were advised to try out a new medicine for migraine by Dr. Verma.*
